intro:
I'm **Jeff**, known online as **Skiddle**. I'm based in Bangkok and run **Skiddle Labs Pte. Ltd.**, my own company. Since Q3 2026, my team and I have been on a protocol-engineering contract for a client I can't name. My background is in platforms and infrastructure: building pipelines, automating ops, and keeping things running across cloud and my homelab.

I co-founded **Aerialite**, a security and privacy startup here in Bangkok, and now sit on its advisory board. Skiddle Labs is also home to my personal projects and the clients I've worked with for years, and Skiddle ID is part of it. The full version is on my [CV](/works/), and the open-source bits are on [projects](/projects/).

contact.blurb: For work, email is best. For everything else, Bluesky is where I hang out.

current: Protocol engineering, my master's, and flying.
outside: I have ADHD, and it doesn't stop me doing the work. I game, I read, and I keep odd hours. I'm also a private pilot: I earned my PPL in early 2026, and I write about [how that journey started](/topics/tag/aviation/). I care about open protocols and owning your own data, and I'm into ATProto. Curious what I run all this on? It's on the [uses](/uses/) page.

timeline.text: Started blogging, on Jekyll and GitHub Pages.
Built Klasemate, my first app from scratch: open-source forum software in PHP.
First infra engineer role: LDAP, device management, backups.
Founded Skiddle ID, building web apps and running infrastructure for clients. It’s now part of Skiddle Labs.
Started a bachelor's in AI & machine learning at Chulalongkorn.
Co-founded Aerialite, a security & privacy startup in Bangkok, as DevOps engineer.
Launched CheckDomain and Blocklist, and started my master's.
Moved to Aerialite's advisory board and started pilot ground school.
Earned my Private Pilot License, then took on a protocol-engineering contract with my Skiddle Labs team.
